responsibility: Declares the visitor framework for traversing the D front end AST. It forward-declares the major node classes and provides `ParseTimeVisitor`, `Visitor`, and `StoppableVisitor` with overloaded `visit` methods that encode the class hierarchy for statements, types, symbols, initializers, expressions, template parameters, and conditions, enabling analyses, pretty-printers, semantic helpers, and transformations to walk heterogeneous AST nodes through the common `accept` interface.
